question: What is said about citation presence versus citation support in long-context answers?
required_claim: A citation marker can appear without truly supporting the claim; support must be checked.

passages.text: The greenhouse temperature alarm was tested on Monday morning.
A soft-skill workshop flyer was posted near Elevator 3.
Cite note P: Models sometimes emit a passage id next to a claim even when that passage does not contain the supporting fact.
The chemistry stockroom required goggles for all visitors.
A lost ID card was turned in at the security desk.
The debate club ordered extra timers for the weekend tournament.
Cite note Q: Evaluation should distinguish citation presence from citation support—whether the cited span actually justifies the generated claim.
